description: Cesium AI Evaluation Framework - an autonomous proposal and evaluation loop that generates CesiumJS in a browser-backed runner, runs deterministic checks plus three-judge pairwise A/B/TIE visual comparison, and applies a rule-based KEEP/REJECT/TIE decision. Candidate generation and machine decision require no interactive input; changing the live SKILL.md is a separate, explicit human promotion gate.

userStories.title: Implement autonomous candidate decision engine
userStories.description: As the framework, I need a rule-based KEEP/REJECT/TIE engine that resolves candidate outcomes deterministically without conflating a tie with a candidate win.
acceptanceCriteria: The TypeScript decision engine returns { decision: 'KEEP' | 'REJECT' | 'TIE', rule_fired, counts: {wins, losses, ties, critical_failures}, rationale }

Rules applied in order: (1) any non-environment programmatic check failure -> REJECT, (2) any judge loss on a regression-critical scenario -> REJECT, (3) candidate wins > baseline wins -> KEEP, (4) baseline wins > candidate wins -> REJECT, (5) tie -> TIE and retain current best
All five machine rules resolve without prompting; KEEP alone means the candidate explicitly won and is eligible for human review
Optional --override flag with rationale string is supported on a wrapper CLI but never required
Writes decision.json to optimization/results/<skill>/<iteration>/
Tests pass exercising each of the five rules and the override path
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement autonomous iteration loop with guarded promotion
userStories.description: As an operator, I want candidate generation and evaluation to run without interactive pauses while live-skill mutation remains separately approval-gated.
acceptanceCriteria: Create optimization/scripts/run-loop.py with CLI: <skill> --max-iterations N --stop-on plateau|regression|max --plateau-n M

Each iteration: proposer -> skills adapter (all scenarios) -> browser runner -> deterministic checks -> three-judge panel -> decision engine -> report generator -> append to optimization/history/<skill>/iteration-NNN/

On KEEP: stage the candidate as PROMOTED-PENDING.md by default and stop for human review; only --promote or optimize promote may apply it. On REJECT or TIE: preserve history and leave current best unchanged
Stops on: max iterations, M consecutive ties, unrecoverable runner error, SIGINT
No interactive input occurs inside proposal, generation, rendering, judging, or machine decision; promotion is a separate explicit action
Tests pass for stopping conditions using mocked subcomponents
Typecheck passes
